brief.headline: Push for a 5–10% price cut and faster payment — they keep 8.5% profit vs 4.8% for similar firms, so there's clear room to give

priceAsk.summary: Ask for a 5–10% price cut on rigid plastic packaging
priceAsk.target: Target the ₹0.65–0.80/pc band (market research shows modest headroom at higher volume)
priceAsk.basis: They keep 8.5% profit while similar firms keep 4.8% — that 3.7-point gap is room in their price. Market research shows caps at ₹0.85–0.95/pc typically, with headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at scale.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Move from 45 days to 30 days after receipt
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: Frees up ₹2.15 L of cash for us

brief.financialLeverage: Triveni is healthy — they made ₹179.69 Cr in sales and keep 8.5% as profit, well above the 4.8% that similar packaging firms keep. They carry zero debt (0.00x) and their cash is stuck for 124 days (longer than the 114-day norm), so cash is a bit tight for them. We're tiny at ₹26.17 L — just 0.15% of their sales — so on our own we have little pull. Bundle more volume, commit longer, or name a credible alternate (Mold-Tek or Manjushree) to gain leverage.

evidence.point: They keep 8.5% profit while similar firms keep 4.8% — clear room to give on price
Their cash is stuck for 124 days, longer than similar firms at 114 days — so faster payment has real value to them
We're a very small customer — just 0.15% of their total sales
Market research shows typical cap prices at ₹0.85–0.95/pc with headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume
evidence.figure: ₹0.55–1.20/pc ask band, ₹0.85–0.95/pc typical, modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80

evidence.point: They carry zero debt and cover interest 75.84 times — financially strong
EPF payment delays flagged — a minor compliance watch-out

alternates.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd
alternates.why: India's largest rigid-plastic packaging converter at ₹2569.83 Cr revenue — pharma bottles, caps, preforms — top second-source candidate with B (65/100) health

alternates.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd
alternates.why: Listed rigid-plastic leader at ₹1010.97 Cr revenue — pails, containers, pharma — robust alternate with B (73/100) health

risks: We're only 0.15% of their business — too small to matter unless we bundle more volume or commit longer term
EPF payment delays are on record — a compliance red flag to watch, though their overall health is solid at B (70/100)
Their cash is stuck for 124 days vs 114-day peer norm — they may resist shorter payment terms even though it would help them
Market backups (Reliance, IVL Dhunseri, Chemco) are leads to qualify — verify capability and price before using them as leverage
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We'd like to talk about price and payment terms — you're keeping 8.5% profit while similar firms keep 4.8%, so we see room to improve our deal, and we're ready to move faster on payment if the price works.
